text:
Invited Seminars and Presentations
Regular presenter at international conferences (Society for Economic Dynamics, AFA, WFA, LACEA/LAMES, Brazilian Society of Econometrics), multilateral institutions, central banks (Banco de Portugal, Federal Reserve Banks, Banco Central do Brasil), and leading universities across Brazil, the United States, and Europe.
Recent presentations (2023-2026) include the International Monetary Fund, FGV-EESP, INSPER, the Lubramacro conference series, PUC Chile, and the Society for Economic Dynamics (SED) Annual Meeting (Athens, 2026).
A full list is available in the Lattes CV.

title: Felipe S. Iachan
text:
I am an Associate Professor of Economics and Finance at FGV EPGE. I hold a PhD in Economics from MIT, obtained in 2012.
My research examines how financial, informational, and institutional frictions influence the macroeconomy and asset prices.
I have studied portfolio choice and asset pricing, labor market dynamics and inequality, monetary policy transmission, credit constraints and investment, coordination in financial markets, and the role of informality in housing and labor markets.
Research Interests: Macroeconomics, Financial Economics
